title: Fleetplane configuration
description: Configuration file for `fleetplane serve` (ADR-007). Decoding is STRICT: any key not defined here is a boot error. Durations are Go duration strings ("20s", "1m30s", "15m"). Credentials should always be secret:// references (secret://env/NAME or secret://file/PATH), never plaintext.

providers.title: Provider instances
providers.description: Map of instance name (yours to choose: hetzner-main, do-fra1, ...) to provider configuration. Two instances of the same driver are fine. Instances are constructed at boot: a bad settings block, a missing credential, or an unresolvable secret:// reference fails `fleetplane serve` immediately.

classes.title: Classes (creation templates)
classes.description: Map of class name to reusable creation template (docs 04 §2). A resource created "from class X" expands the class spec; pools also target classes. A class referencing an unknown provider is a boot error.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Go duration string (time.ParseDuration): decimal numbers each with a unit suffix, optionally concatenated. Valid units: ns, us, µs, ms, s, m, h. An invalid duration is a boot error.

secretRef.title: secret:// reference
secretRef.description: Secret reference resolved at boot and never logged or persisted (ADR-007, docs 07 §4). Schemes: secret://env/NAME reads the environment variable NAME (unset variable is a boot error); secret://file/PATH reads the file at the absolute path /PATH (one trailing newline trimmed; unreadable file is a boot error).

addr.title: Main API listen address
addr.description: Serves /v1/*, /health/*, and the embedded web dashboard at /ui/ (/ redirects there). Default ":8080".

opsAddr.title: Ops listen address
opsAddr.description: Serves /metrics (Prometheus), /debug/pprof/*, and POST /admin/backup. Default "127.0.0.1:9090". Keep it loopback-only unless the network is trusted.

shutdownGrace.title: Graceful shutdown bound
shutdownGrace.description: Bound on graceful shutdown: readiness flips to false, in-flight HTTP drains within this window, then providers and the store close. In-flight provider operations resume from the journal on next boot. Default 20s.

storage.title: storage
storage.description: Persistent state location. Fleetplane uses SQLite in WAL mode (ADR-003).

path.title: SQLite database file path
path.description: REQUIRED. Missing or empty is a boot error (`storage.path is required`).

provider.title: Provider instance
provider.description: One provider instance (docs 03 §4): a driver plus its raw settings block, and optional per-kind billing overrides.

driver.title: Driver name
driver.description: REQUIRED. Which driver implements this instance. The shape of `settings` depends on this value.

settings.title: Driver settings
settings.description: Raw driver config block, decoded by the driver itself at boot; the shape depends on the sibling `driver`. Credentials inside must be secret:// references (secret://env/NAME or secret://file/PATH).

billing.title: Billing overrides (per resource kind)
billing.description: Optional per-kind overrides of the driver's billing policy — the input to cost-aware leasing (docs 11, ADR-018). Map of resource kind (e.g. compute.machine) to override. Overrides merge field-wise over the driver's declared policy: an unset field keeps the driver's value. Override kinds are validated against the driver's declared kinds at boot.

billingOverride.title: Billing override for one kind
billingOverride.description: Tunes one kind's billing policy (docs 11). Fields merge over the driver's declared policy; `disabled: true` is the explicit opt-out and may not be combined with the other fields (boot error).

disabled.title: Opt out of billing-window behavior
disabled.description: Explicit opt-out: the kind gets the zero (fine-grained) policy and no billing-window behavior. May NOT be combined with the other fields — that is a boot error.

minimumDuration.title: Minimum billed duration
minimumDuration.description: Shortest period the provider ever bills (0 = none). Must be >= 0. Unset keeps the driver's value.

increment.title: Billing increment
increment.description: Billing granularity after the minimum (0 = fine-grained, per-use). Must be >= 0. Unset keeps the driver's value.

terminationBuffer.title: Termination buffer
terminationBuffer.description: How long before a billing boundary a delete is dispatched so provider-side termination completes inside the paid window. Must be >= 0. Unset keeps the driver's value.

adaptive.title: Adaptive termination buffer
adaptive.description: Derive the termination buffer from observed provider deletion durations (p95 + margin, floored by terminationBuffer, capped at half the increment — docs 11 §12).

then.description: disabled: true may not be combined with the other billing fields (boot error).

fakeSettings.title: fake driver settings
fakeSettings.description: In-memory provider serving compute.machine and storage.volume, used by tests and conformance suites. No credentials. The zero value is fully synchronous (creates land running, lists see everything at once); the knobs introduce deterministic asynchrony. Unknown keys are rejected at boot.

createSteps.title: Create steps
createSteps.description: ObserveOperation calls until a create lands `running`. 0 (default) = creates land running immediately.

deleteSteps.title: Delete steps
deleteSteps.description: ObserveOperation calls until a delete lands gone. 0 (default) = deletes complete immediately.

listLagSteps.title: List lag steps
listLagSteps.description: Discover calls before a new object becomes listable (list-consistency lag). 0 (default) = immediately listable.

pageSize.title: Discover page size
pageSize.description: Internal Discover pagination chunk (0 = single page).

billing.title: Declared billing policies (per kind)
billing.description: Per-kind billing policies the fake driver declares (docs 11) — the test control for billing-window behavior. Map of resource kind (e.g. compute.machine) to policy.

fakeBillingSettings.title: fake billing policy for one kind
fakeBillingSettings.description: One kind's declared billing policy (docs 11): minimum, increment, and termination buffer as Go duration strings.

terminationBuffer.title: Termination buffer
terminationBuffer.description: How long before a billing boundary a delete is dispatched.

hetznerSettings.title: hetzner driver settings
hetznerSettings.description: Drives compute.machine on Hetzner Cloud via the official hcloud-go v2 SDK. SDK-level retries are disabled — the operation engine is the only retry authority (ADR-014). Default billing policy: hourly increment + 5m termination buffer for compute.machine.

token.title: Hetzner Cloud API token
token.description: REQUIRED. Use a secret:// reference — secret://env/NAME or secret://file/PATH. A plain literal is used as the credential as-is (it will work, but the token then sits in plaintext in the config file — don't do this outside throwaway experiments).

location.title: Default server location
location.description: Default placement for created servers (e.g. fsn1). A class spec's `location` wins over this.

endpoint.title: API endpoint override
endpoint.description: Test override of the Hetzner API endpoint. Leave unset in production.

rps.title: Requests per second
rps.description: Request-rate limit toward the Hetzner API. 5 when zero/unset.

maxConcurrent.title: Max concurrent API calls
maxConcurrent.description: Maximum concurrent in-flight API calls. 5 when zero/unset.

digitaloceanSettings.title: digitalocean driver settings
digitaloceanSettings.description: Drives compute.machine on DigitalOcean droplets via godo. Same retry stance as Hetzner: the engine owns all retries. Default billing policy: hourly increment + 5m termination buffer for compute.machine.

token.title: DigitalOcean API token
token.description: REQUIRED. Use a secret:// reference — secret://env/NAME or secret://file/PATH. A plain literal is used as the credential as-is (plaintext in the config file — avoid).

region.title: Default droplet region
region.description: Default placement for created droplets (e.g. fra1). A class spec's `location` wins over this.

endpoint.title: API endpoint override
endpoint.description: Test override of the DigitalOcean API endpoint. Leave unset in production.

rps.title: Requests per second
rps.description: Request-rate limit toward the DigitalOcean API. 5 when zero/unset.

maxConcurrent.title: Max concurrent API calls
maxConcurrent.description: Maximum concurrent in-flight API calls. 5 when zero/unset.

awsSettings.title: aws driver settings
awsSettings.description: Drives compute.machine on AWS EC2. Static credentials are optional: omit accessKeyId/secretAccessKey entirely to use the ambient AWS credential chain (env vars, shared config, IMDS role). SDK retries are capped at one attempt — the engine owns retries (ADR-014).

region.title: AWS region
region.description: REQUIRED. Region for all EC2 calls (e.g. eu-central-1).

accessKeyId.title: Static access key ID
accessKeyId.description: Use a secret:// reference — secret://env/NAME or secret://file/PATH. All-or-nothing with secretAccessKey; omit both to use the ambient AWS credential chain. A plain literal is used as the credential as-is (plaintext in the config file — avoid).

secretAccessKey.title: Static secret access key
secretAccessKey.description: Use a secret:// reference — secret://env/NAME or secret://file/PATH. All-or-nothing with accessKeyId. A plain literal is used as the credential as-is (plaintext in the config file — avoid).

sessionToken.title: Static session token
sessionToken.description: Optional session token for temporary credentials; requires the accessKeyId/secretAccessKey pair. Use a secret:// reference.

endpoint.title: API endpoint override
endpoint.description: Test override of the EC2 endpoint. Leave unset in production.

subnetId.title: Subnet ID
subnetId.description: Subnet to launch instances into (e.g. subnet-0abc...). Unset = the region's default VPC/subnet.

securityGroupIds.title: Security group IDs
securityGroupIds.description: Security groups attached to launched instances.

keyName.title: EC2 key pair name
keyName.description: Name of the EC2 key pair installed on launched instances.

instanceProfile.title: IAM instance profile name
instanceProfile.description: IAM instance profile attached to launched instances.

rps.title: Requests per second
rps.description: Request-rate limit toward the EC2 API. Driver default when zero/unset.

burst.title: Rate-limiter burst
burst.description: Rate-limiter burst size. Driver default when zero/unset.

maxConcurrent.title: Max concurrent API calls
maxConcurrent.description: Maximum concurrent in-flight API calls. Driver default when zero/unset.

gcpSettings.title: gcp driver settings
gcpSettings.description: Drives compute.machine on Google Compute Engine. Credentials: a secret:// reference to a service-account key JSON, or omit credentialsJson to use Application Default Credentials. Default billing policy: 60s minimum for compute.machine.

project.title: GCP project ID
project.description: REQUIRED. Project all instances are created in and discovered from.

zone.title: Default zone
zone.description: REQUIRED. Default zone for created instances (e.g. europe-west3-a). A class spec's `location` wins over this.

credentialsJson.title: Service-account key (secret:// reference)
credentialsJson.description: secret:// reference to a service-account key JSON — secret://env/NAME or secret://file/PATH. MUST be a secret:// reference (a plain literal is a boot error). Omit to use Application Default Credentials.

endpoint.title: API endpoint override
endpoint.description: Test override of the Compute Engine endpoint (disables authentication). Leave unset in production.

network.title: VPC network
network.description: Network to attach instances to. Unset = the project default network.

rps.title: Requests per second
rps.description: Request-rate limit toward the GCE API. Driver default when zero/unset.

burst.title: Rate-limiter burst
burst.description: Rate-limiter burst size. Driver default when zero/unset.

maxConcurrent.title: Max concurrent API calls
maxConcurrent.description: Maximum concurrent in-flight API calls. Driver default when zero/unset.

class.title: Class (creation template)
class.description: A reusable creation template (docs 04 §2). `spec` is kind-specific and may carry provider-specific extras; `reclaim.idleAfter` enables poolless idle reclamation; `scheduling.queue` sets the cost/latency tradeoff.

kind.title: Resource kind
kind.description: REQUIRED. Which resource kind this class creates.

provider.title: Provider instance name
provider.description: REQUIRED. Name of a configured provider instance (a key under top-level `providers`). Referencing an unknown provider is a boot error.

spec.title: Kind-specific spec
spec.description: The creation spec for this class's kind. Provider-specific extra fields are allowed and passed through to the driver.

reclaim.title: Idle reclamation
reclaim.description: Poolless idle reclamation (plan R21): resources created from this class are deleted automatically once idle. Absent = never auto-reclaimed.

idleAfter.title: Idle threshold
idleAfter.description: A class-created resource that is ready, has no active leases, and is not delete-protected is drained and deleted after being idle this long (a journaled delete, counted against the reconciler's mutation budget).

queue.title: Queue policy
queue.description: maxWait > 0 lets acquisitions of this class wait for existing or in-flight capacity before scaling up (sequential lease packing); 0/absent = provision immediately.

maxWait.title: Queue budget
maxWait.description: How long acquisitions of this class wait for existing/in-flight capacity before force-scaling. Must be >= 0 and must not exceed acquire.pendingTimeout (boot error). The effective per-acquisition value is clamped to pendingTimeout - 10s at accept time. A per-request maxWait overrides this default.

computeMachineSpec.title: compute.machine spec
computeMachineSpec.description: Creation spec for a machine. Capacity dimensions for scheduling: cpu, memoryMiB. Provider-specific extra fields are passed through to the driver.

serverType.title: Server type
serverType.description: REQUIRED. Provider server type (e.g. cpx31 on Hetzner, s-2vcpu-4gb on DigitalOcean, t3.small on AWS, e2-medium on GCP).

image.title: Image reference
image.description: REQUIRED. Image reference; syntax is per-driver. Hetzner: id:<n> | name:<os> | snapshot:<label-selector>. DigitalOcean: id:<n> | slug:<distro-slug> | snapshot:<name>.

location.title: Placement
location.description: Placement (location/region/zone); overrides the provider's default location/region/zone setting.

userData.title: Cloud-init user data
userData.description: Cloud-init user data passed to the machine at creation.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels applied to the provider resource (verbatim on Hetzner; encoded as fp-tags on DigitalOcean, where unknown keys are dropped).

readinessSpec.title: Readiness probe
readinessSpec.description: Post-create gate executed by the operation engine after the provider reports success: the machine only becomes ready once the probe passes. Declare EXACTLY ONE of `tcp` or `http` — both, or neither, is a validation error. Targets the machine's first usable address (public IPv4, then public IPv6, then private).

tcp.title: TCP probe
tcp.description: Passes when a TCP connection to the port succeeds. Mutually exclusive with `http`.

port.title: Port
port.description: REQUIRED. Port to dial; must be 1-65535.

http.title: HTTP probe
http.description: GET http://<addr>:<port><path>; passes on the expected status. Mutually exclusive with `tcp`.

port.title: Port
port.description: REQUIRED. Port for the request; must be 1-65535.

expectStatus.title: Expected status code
expectStatus.description: Exact status code required; 0 (default) means any 2xx passes.

initialDelay.title: Initial delay
initialDelay.description: Wait before the first attempt. Default 0s.

budget.title: Total budget
budget.description: Total time before the probe declares failure. Default 5m.

storageVolumeSpec.title: storage.volume spec
storageVolumeSpec.description: Creation spec for a volume. Capacity dimension for scheduling: storageGiB. Provider-specific extra fields are passed through to the driver.

zone.title: Placement zone
zone.description: Zone the volume is created in.

engine.title: engine
engine.description: Tunes the operation engine — the component that executes every provider mutation exactly once via a persistent journal (ADR-014, ADR-017). Built-in defaults apply when zero/unset.

pollInterval.title: Engine wake-up cadence
pollInterval.description: Fallback wake-up interval — in-process kicks are the primary trigger, so there is rarely a reason to change it. 2s when zero/unset.

verifyWindow.title: Uncertain-create verification window
verifyWindow.description: How long a create with an unknown outcome (crash mid-call, ambiguous provider answer) is probed before the operation freezes as `uncertain` for manual :resolve (plan R10). 120s when zero/unset.

maxMutationsPerCycle.title: Mutation budget per cycle
maxMutationsPerCycle.description: The one budget knob (plan R22): maximum provider mutations (creates, deletes, reclaims) per reconcile cycle, across pools. Caps blast radius when a pool spec is wrong. 5 when zero/unset.

pendingTimeout.title: Pending acquisition timeout
pendingTimeout.description: Acquisitions that were never satisfied (no capacity, provider down) expire after this long instead of pending forever (plan R6). Defaulted at config load to 15m; also caps every class's scheduling.queue.maxWait.

discovery.title: discovery
discovery.description: Tunes the provider discovery sweep (ADR-017) — the loop that compares what the provider actually has against Fleetplane's records and resolves ghosts and orphans. Only runs against providers whose health is healthy or unknown.

orphanGrace.title: Orphan grace
orphanGrace.description: Grace between confirming a local record's provider resource is gone (by direct read, not just absent from a list) and tombstoning the record as orphaned. 60s when zero/unset.

ghostPolicy.title: Ghost policy
ghostPolicy.description: What to do with a ghost — a provider resource carrying Fleetplane's labels but matching no live record. `delete` (default): reclaim it via a journaled delete. `surface`: record it, log a warning, and leave deletion to you.

adoptUnlabeled.title: Unlabeled-resource policy
adoptUnlabeled.description: What to do with provider resources carrying NO Fleetplane labels. `off` (default): ignore them entirely (the sweep only lists owned resources). `observed`: list everything and record unlabeled resources with ownership `observed` — visible in the inventory, never mutated. Quote the value ("off") so YAML does not read it as a boolean.

auth.title: auth
auth.description: Static API tokens (docs 07 §2, ADR-008). With no tokens configured the API runs OPEN — every request is allowed; local development only, boot logs a loud warning.

tokens.title: Static token records
tokens.description: Generate an entry with: fleetplane token new --name <name> --perm <perm> ... (prints the plaintext once plus the ready-to-paste YAML). Clients present tokens as `Authorization: Bearer flp_<id8>.<secret>`.

token.title: API token record
token.description: One static token: only the SHA-256 of the secret is ever stored (ADR-008).

id.title: Token ID
id.description: REQUIRED. Lookup prefix (8 hex chars by convention; the <id8> in flp_<id8>.<secret>). Duplicate IDs are a boot error.

name.title: Token name
name.description: Human name; shown in audit events and 403 messages.

sha256.title: Secret hash
sha256.description: REQUIRED. Hex SHA-256 of the token secret; must be exactly 64 hex characters. The plaintext secret is never stored anywhere.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Permission names from the closed set. An unknown permission name is a boot error. A token holding `admin` passes every permission check.

items.title: Permission
items.description: resource.read: list/read resources and acquisitions. resource.acquire: acquire and release. resource.create / resource.delete: create, delete, drain. pool.read / pool.write: read and manage pools. class.read / class.write: read and manage classes. provider.read: provider health. provider.admin: resolve uncertain operations (:resolve). operation.read: operations and audit events. admin: everything.
